title: Product & Operations Sync — Onboarding Flow, Meeting Notes Automation, Q3 Budget Review
agenda: New onboarding flow progress and next steps
Meeting notes automation — AI solution proposal
discussion_points: Sarah's team completed wireframes for the new onboarding flow last week; design team reviewed them and flagged mobile layout issues requiring another revision round.
Revised wireframes are estimated to take 3–4 days, targeting Thursday delivery to developers.
Anas's team can begin back-end API endpoint setup in parallel using the existing database schema from the old flow, estimating approximately one week for back-end work.
Omar proposed building a meeting intelligence agent that auto-generates structured meeting minutes from recordings or notes using the company template, and pushes action items to Microsoft Planner.
Omar needs access to Azure Speech API and SharePoint templates to build the proof of concept; both blockers were addressed in the meeting.
Q3 budget review is scheduled for next Monday; all department heads must submit budget estimates by Friday.
decisions: Sarah will own the wireframe revisions and deliver them to developers by Thursday.
Anas's team will begin back-end API endpoint development in parallel with the wireframe revision.
Omar's meeting intelligence agent proof of concept is designated a priority initiative.
Omar has two weeks to deliver a proof of concept for the meeting intelligence agent.
Meeting Lead will provision Azure resources (Speech API) by tomorrow.
Anas will grant Omar access to the SharePoint templates library today.
All department heads must submit Q3 budget estimates by Friday — no exceptions.

action_items.task: Complete revised onboarding flow wireframes addressing mobile layout feedback and hand off to development team
Begin back-end API endpoint setup for the new onboarding flow, extending existing database schema
Build and deliver a proof of concept for the meeting intelligence agent (auto-generates structured minutes and pushes action items to Planner)
Provision Azure Speech API resources and grant Omar access
Send Omar the link to the SharePoint templates library
Submit department Q3 budget estimate ahead of Monday's budget review

follow_ups: Confirm that Sarah's revised wireframes were successfully handed off to the development team by Thursday and that developers have no blocking questions.
Check in with Omar mid-week to ensure Azure Speech API access and SharePoint template access are both confirmed and unblocking POC development.
Monitor Anas's back-end API progress to ensure the one-week estimate stays on track and aligns with the wireframe handoff timeline.
Verify all departments submitted their Q3 budget estimates by Friday ahead of Monday's review meeting.
Evaluate Omar's meeting intelligence agent POC after the two-week window and decide on next steps for full implementation and rollout.
